title: 第6章 西边捡来的项西(6)

content_zh:
“你是大夫？”那个男人盯着他。
“嗯，骨科，”程博衍点点头，“急诊大夫都忙着呢，我给看看，你们别着急。”
“骨科？那正好！”男人指着坐在椅子上的人，又看了看手表，有些着急地说，“您给看看，严重吗？是骨折吗？”
“撞哪儿了？”程博衍蹲在这人跟前问。
坐在椅子上的人一直低着头，程博衍问了话，他才终于抬起了头。
说实话急诊经常有碰瓷的过来，有真骨折的，也有三周以上的陈旧性骨折的，还有听说要拍片就溜了的，阵式跟眼前这出都差不多。
程博衍心里暂时给这帮人定了个性，特别是被撞的这位，程博衍过来第一眼看到他莫西干的脑袋时就没什么好感，再加上打着铜扣的皮靴和那条也不知道是七分还是九分的裤子……大冷天的。
这人抬头之后程博衍看清了他的脸，右眼角下边贴着片小号的卡通创可贴，看着比瘸腿那位年纪还要小些，挺清秀，眼神里是跟他这身造型都不相符的迷茫，透着天真和无辜。
“左小腿。”这人指了指自己的腿，声音很平静，跟他一直嚷嚷着让人脑浆都快熬出泡了的朋友形成鲜明对比。
“我先看看，”程博衍示意他把裤腿撩上去，“疼吗？”
“还骨科大夫呢，”这人一边拉着裤腿一边不急不慢地说，“你们骨科碰到过被撞成这样了都不疼的神人吗？”
说话还挺冲，程博衍看了他一眼，没吭声。
小腿已经肿起来了，看着倒是新伤，而且伤得不轻，没准得住院，程博衍伸手想按压确定一下，刚碰到腿上的皮肤，这人就拍开了他的手。
“哥，”他皱着眉，“很疼。”
程博衍盯着他的眼睛看了几秒钟，站了起来：“叫什么名字？得拍个片。”
“展宏图，”这人回答，说到自己的名字时他笑了笑，“大展宏图的展宏图。”
一听说是骨折了，还不轻，旁边的几个人都喊上了，围着那个男人再次开始嚷嚷，男人看了看表，问程博衍：“大夫，这还要多久能完？”
“一个多小时吧，要看骨折的程度。”程博衍拿出手机，准备给放射科打个电话，看看能不能马上做。
旁边几个人嚷得实在让人心烦，他走到了旁边的楼道里打电话。
跟放射科联系完了，回到急诊门口的时候，程博衍发现四周已经安静了不少，那个男人似乎已经离开了，椅子那儿只剩下了那三个年轻人。

其中一个手上拿着一沓钱。
给钱了？
“去交一下费，到二楼拍个片，电梯在那边，”程博衍也没多问，交代了一下，“检查完了会有值班医生给你处理。”
“谢谢程大夫。”叫展宏图的那个男孩看着他说了一句。
“嗯？”程博衍愣了愣。
“刚刚急诊的大夫不是叫你小程吗？”
“哦，是，”程博衍说，“不客气。”
回到家程博衍倒是挺饿的，但不太想吃饭，一想到要吃自己做的饭就有点儿悲愤交加，食欲全无。
他换了衣服往沙发上一靠闭上了眼睛，琢磨着要不要叫个外卖。
刚闭上眼睛，就听到了对面楼挂在阳台的两对虎皮鹦鹉半疯狂式的叫声。
“唉……”他叹了口气，捏了捏眉心。
楼距太近，听着跟菜市场声嘶力竭吵架似的声音，程博衍无奈地睁开了眼睛，皱着眉定了定神，又闭上眼睛，努力控制着自己的情绪深呼吸了几个来回，这才把想拉开窗用弹弓把对面那笼鸟打掉的冲动压了下去。
这两对鹦鹉是上个月被拎回来的，因为都是蓝色的，比起平时看到的黄的绿的显得好看，程博衍还挺有兴趣地在窗口看了一会儿，默默地给它们起了名字，大蓝、二蓝、三蓝和四蓝。
现在想想，自己真是太天真了，现在只想叫它们大泼、二泼、三泼和四泼。
最后他进屋算了，不吃了。
“回吧？”馒头架着项西，站在街边来回看着，想找个三蹦子。
“嗯。”项西皱着眉应了一声。
“今儿都碰好几个了，刚刚这个算是大出血了，要不你就治了吧？”馒头低头看了看他的腿，“别拖时间长了跟我似的……”
“滚煤堆了吧，你？”项西瞅着他。
“啊？”馒头愣了愣。

content_en:
"Are you a doctor?" The man stared at him.
"Well, orthopedics," Cheng Boyan nodded, "the emergency doctors are busy, I'll take a look, don't worry."
"Orthopedics? That's perfect!" The man pointed at the person sitting on the chair, looked at his watch, and said anxiously, "Can you please take a look, is it serious? Is it a fracture?"
"Where did it hit?" Cheng Boyan squatted in front of the man and asked.
The person sitting on the chair kept his head down. After Cheng Boyan asked, he finally raised his head.
To be honest, the emergency department often sees people with broken bones, some with real fractures, some with old fractures that are more than three weeks old, and some who left after hearing that they were going to take X-rays. The formations are similar to the one in front of me.
Cheng Boyan temporarily decided on the personality of this group of people, especially the one who was hit. When Cheng Boyan came over and saw his mohawked head for the first time, he didn't like it. In addition, the leather boots with copper buckles and the pants that were not sure whether they were seven or nine points... It was a cold day.
When the man raised his head, Cheng Boyan saw his face clearly. There was a small cartoon Band-Aid stuck under the corner of his right eye. He looked younger than the lame man, quite delicate, and his eyes were confused and seemed to be incompatible with his appearance, showing innocence and innocence.
"Left calf." The man pointed to his leg, his voice was very calm, which was in sharp contrast to his friend who kept yelling that made people's brains boil.
"Let me take a look first," Cheng Boyan motioned for him to lift up his trouser legs, "Does it hurt?"
"Here's an orthopedic surgeon," the man said calmly while pulling up his trouser legs. "Have you ever encountered an orthopedic surgeon who doesn't even feel pain after being hit like this?"
The words were quite irritable, Cheng Boyan glanced at him and said nothing.
The calf was already swollen. It looked like a new injury, and the injury was serious. He might have to be hospitalized. Cheng Boyan stretched out his hand to make sure it was pressed. As soon as it touched the skin of the leg, the man slapped his hand away.
"Brother," he frowned, "it hurts."
Cheng Boyan stared into his eyes for a few seconds, then stood up: "What's your name? I need to take a picture."
"Zhan Hongtu," the man replied, smiling when his name was mentioned, "Zhan Hongtu, Zhan Hongtu."
When they heard that it was a broken bone and it was not serious, several people nearby called out and started shouting around the man again. The man looked at his watch and asked Cheng Boyan: "Doctor, how long will it take to finish?"
"It will take more than an hour, depending on the extent of the fracture." Cheng Boyan took out his mobile phone and prepared to call the radiology department to see if it could be done immediately.
The shouting of several people nearby was really annoying, so he went to the nearby corridor to make a phone call.
After contacting the radiology department, when he returned to the emergency door, Cheng Boyan found that the surroundings had become much quieter. The man seemed to have left, and only the three young men were left in the chair.
One of them held a wad of money in his hand.
Did you give money?
"Go and pay the fee and go to the second floor to take a X-ray. The elevator is over there," Cheng Boyan said without asking any further questions. "After the examination, there will be a doctor on duty who will take care of it for you."
"Thank you, Doctor Cheng." The boy named Zhan Hongtu looked at him and said.
"Huh?" Cheng Boyan was stunned.
"Didn't the doctor who gave the emergency call just now call you Xiao Cheng?"
"Oh, yes," Cheng Boyan said, "You're welcome."
Cheng Boyan was quite hungry when he got home, but he didn't really want to eat. The thought of eating the food he cooked made him feel a little sad and angry, and he lost his appetite.
He changed his clothes, leaned back on the sofa and closed his eyes, wondering whether to order takeout.
As soon as I closed my eyes, I heard the semi-crazy screams of two pairs of budgerigars hanging on the balcony across the building.
"Alas..." He sighed and pinched his eyebrows.
The building was too close. Hearing the noise that sounded like a shouting match in the vegetable market, Cheng Boyan opened his eyes helplessly, frowned and calmed down, closed his eyes again, and tried to control his emotions and took a few deep breaths.After going back and forth, I suppressed the urge to open the window and use a slingshot to knock out the caged bird opposite.
These two pairs of parrots were brought back last month. Because they were both blue, they looked more beautiful than the yellow and green ones they usually saw. Cheng Boyan watched them at the window with interest for a while, and silently named them, Big Blue, Second Blue, Third Blue and Fourth Blue.
Thinking about it now, I was so naive. Now I just want to call them big splash, second splash, third splash and fourth splash.
Finally he went inside and gave up and stopped eating.
"Go back?" Mantou held Xiang west and stood on the street looking back and forth, trying to find a threesome.
"Yeah." Xiang west frowned and responded.
"I've had quite a few of them today. This one was a massive hemorrhage. Why don't you just treat it?" Mantou looked down at his leg, "Don't delay it for too long, like me..."
"The coals are piled up, are you?" Xiang west looked at him.
"Ah?" Steamed Bun was stunned.
